_comment: Current certificates of analysis, supplied by the operator as PDFs in the
repository's 'lab tests' folder and converted to JPEG here -- Solidus product
galleries hold images, and Active Storage would refuse to build variants of a
PDF. Each COA is two pages, converted at 150 DPI and kept as two images so the
certificate stays complete; page 2 carries the disclaimers and the lab's
Keyed by b2b_product_id, which is stable across renames and consolidation --
unlike SKU, which product_variants.json moves off the master.
Several COAs cover a whole formula line. The operator confirmed on 2026-08-27
that these attach to every size and flavour of their formula, so a customer
looking at the 2oz sees the same current test results as one looking at the 1oz.
Discontinued products are deliberately absent: both gallon tinctures are off
the storefront, and storing two more images against each costs database space
for a page nobody can reach.
Not listed, and deliberately: the THC-Free Advanced tincture (b2b 248) is a
different formulation from the Advanced tincture and no COA in the batch names
it. It keeps its existing lab test image until the operator supplies one.
Applied by Nsb::LabTestImporter via bin/rails nsb:images:lab_tests.

certificates.coa: green apple CBD 70mg THC free gummies
full spectrum CBD oil infused caramel taffies

_superseded_lab_test_files: The images these COAs supersede. Identified from the source URLs recorded in
WordPress filenames, which name them as lab tests. Listed here so the importer
can place the new certificates directly above them in the gallery, and so the
list is reviewable rather than a regex buried in the code.
The old images are kept, not deleted: a customer may have been sent a link to
one, and superseding is not the same as being wrong.
